subject.facility_name: MANSFIELD CENTER FOR NURSING AND REHABILITATION

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $200.12 per resident day (42.8% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 3.4% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $864,149, 14.8% of the $5,852,992 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,069,463, $36.57 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $598,170 (55.9%), allocated fringe $157,078 (14.7%), non-wage costs $314,215 (29.4%). Raw food was $247,171 ($8.45 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $56,555.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $476,202, $16.28 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $345,477 (72.5%), allocated fringe $90,721 (19.1%), non-wage costs $40,004 (8.4%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $223,128, $7.63 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $110,583 (49.6%), allocated fringe $29,039 (13.0%), non-wage costs $83,506 (37.4%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
